From: Fern Whitcombe
To: Delia
Subject: RE: Tangerine - need broader input before Friday

Delia,
The steering group could not reach consensus on the two options. Lars and Quinn feel strongly that the bench teams need to weigh in directly before we commit resources. A live poll and an open Q&A would be the most efficient route. Can you arrange it?

> From: Jonas Vasquez
> The staffing implications differ substantially between options. Uriel's group and Emeka's group will be affected most. I'd rather surface objections now than after the decision.

Agenda (as approved):
1. Summary of options A and B. Fern Whitcombe (5 min)
2. Impact on lab operations. Uriel Kessler, Emeka Lindqvist (5 min)
3. Open Q&A and live poll [link] (15 min)
4. Next steps. Delia (5 min)
